title: Burst
description: This turn, your next Skill is played an extra time.
smart_description: Your next {Amount:plural:Skill is|[blue]{}[/blue] Skills are} played an extra time this turn.
notes: Burst increments the play count of the next Skill by 1 per stack. Each time a Skill is played with this power active, Burst decrements by 1. The power is automatically removed at the end of your turn if still active.
